# Provenance

One path of the stock MegaMud v2.2 path set, for the path-window tests: `Cry1cry2.mp` (Crypt
Level 1 to Crypt Level 2). It pulls the two levers at 1:1044 and 1:1038 that open the sealed
Hidden exit north of 1:1056, then goes through it to the Small Chamber, 1:1063. Copied on
2026-10-26, byte for byte, from this repository's `data/megamud/Default/` at commit
`bfa9fc1d4bbb596a6b3513add74e7182dfd0a75d` (its own provenance is
`data/megamud/PROVENANCE.md`).

The test pack is built from `tests/fixtures/megamud` with this file added beside it
(`crates/wayfarer-world/tests/common/mod.rs`). Do not edit this file; a card that needs other
paths adds its own subdirectory.
